title: Subscription Renewal Churn
scenario: Identify if a user renewed their subscription (exists in next row) or churned.
hint: Compare renewal_date with the next date using LEAD().
correctQuery: SELECT user_id, renewal_date, CASE WHEN LEAD(renewal_date) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY renewal_date) IS NULL THEN 'Churned' ELSE 'Renewed' END AS status FROM subs;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE subs (user_id INT, renewal_date DATE);
